claims: Continue continuous cardiac and vital sign monitoring with alarms for tachycardia, hypertension, and tachypnea.
Repeat basic metabolic panel and magnesium within 24 hours to reassess electrolytes and anion gap.
Reassess pain and administer multimodal analgesia as needed, including acetaminophen.
Continue supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula at 2 L/min with continuous pulse oximetry.
Perform delirium and sedation assessment with CAM-ICU and Richmond-RAS each shift.
Mobilize patient out of bed with assistance as tolerated, given bedfast status.
Maintain fall precautions and bed rest safety measures given Braden activity score and bedfast status.
Obtain 12-lead ECG if tachycardia persists, given heart rate up to 134 bpm.
Continue home medications including atorvastatin and amlodipine per active orders.
Maintain IV access with saline lock and continue isotonic fluids as ordered.

facts.claim_text: Mobilize patient out of bed with assistance as tolerated, given bedfast status.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The most recent Braden Activity assessment before the decision time (08:44 on 2113-08-05) documents 'Bedfast (1)', consistent with earlier assessments the same day; the 15:30 'Position: Sitting' with head of bed 90 degrees reflects sitting in bed and does not contradict bedfast status.

facts.text: The patient has a documented Braden activity score.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The records explicitly document a Braden Activity score of 'Bedfast (1)', most recently at 08:44 on 2113-08-05, before the decision time.

facts.claim_text: Maintain fall precautions and bed rest safety measures given Braden activity score and bedfast status.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: Repeated Braden Activity assessments document 'Bedfast (1)', most recently at 08:44 on 2113-08-05, within the day before the decision time. Later position entries (e.g., sitting with head of bed elevated) do not contradict the bedfast activity score.

facts.claim_text: Obtain 12-lead ECG if tachycardia persists, given heart rate up to 134 bpm.
facts.text: Heart rate is up to 134 bpm.
facts.label: supported
facts.reason: The stated heart rate (134) matches recorded values before the decision (134 at 2113-08-05 17:00:00).
